title: MayerVietorisOpenExtComparison
statement:
theorem H.openFreeExtComparison (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (M : X.Modules) (W : X.Opens) :
    let F := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj M
    let G := invImage (baseChangeFst (S := S) f)
    let N := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (baseChangedScheme (S := S) f).ringCatSheaf).obj
      (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M)
    let φ := coeff (baseChangeFst (S := S) f) (baseChangeUnit (S := S) f M)
    let ρ := (scalarRep M).comp (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom)
    let τ := (scalarRep (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M)).comp
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv ≫ (baseChangeSnd (S := S) f).appTop).hom)
    ∃ (e : ∀ n, HOver (W.ι ≫ f) ((pullback W.ι).obj M) n ≃+ Ext (H.openFreeSheaf W) F n)
      (e' : ∀ n, HOver (baseChangeSnd (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f))
        (baseChangedModule (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f) ((pullback W.ι).obj M)) n ≃+
        Ext (G.obj (H.openFreeSheaf W)) N n),
      (∀ n a x, e n (a • x) = (e n x).comp (Ext.mk₀ (ρ a)) (add_zero n)) ∧
      (∀ n a x, e' n (a • x) = (e' n x).comp (Ext.mk₀ (τ a)) (add_zero n)) ∧
      (∀ n x, e' n (H.baseChangeLinear (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f) ((pullback W.ι).obj M) n x) =
        ((e n x).mapExactFunctor G).comp (Ext.mk₀ φ) (add_zero n))

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-global-free-ext-comparison] on the open subscheme W with structure map W.ι ≫ f and module (pullback W.ι).obj M. This supplies e_n and e_n′ from the two cohomology terms into Ext from the top-open free sheaf of W and its inverse image, together with their scalar and base-change equations.

Use [lem-pc-open-free-ext-transport] to obtain additive equivalences t_n and t_n′ transporting these Ext groups to Ext from the represented open W in X and its inverse image in X_S. The transport theorem only compares Ext groups and their maps; it does not identify any cohomology term with Ext.

Choose the required equivalences to be e_n.trans t_n and e_n′.trans t_n′. For the R-scalar equation first rewrite by the source scalar equation for e_n, then by the scalar postcomposition equation for t_n. Do the same with e_n′ and t_n′ for the S-scalar equation. For base change first rewrite by the equation for e_n′, then by the cartesian Ext transport equation. Each remaining expression is definitionally the desired composition. These are exactly the three Lean rewrites in the delivered proof; there are no partial-proof sorries.
